title: Streamer.fun
tagline: Streaming platform with AI moderator marketplace & reward system for streamers and viewers.
description:
Streamer.fun is a decentralized streaming platform that changes the way creators and viewers interact. Streamers do not need to spend money on human moderators. Instead, they can create their own customized AI moderators by providing files that set the context. These moderators can manage spam, detect inappropriate chat, handle prediction markets, use retrieval augmented generation for context, and more. All moderators are available in a marketplace where anyone can buy and use them, while the original creator earns money from each use.

Streamer.fun also introduces the idea of time as an asset. Viewers can purchase tokens to spend time with streamers, play games, or interact directly. Ownership of moderators and tools is recorded through NFTs, which ensures fairness and transparency.

To keep the community engaged, the platform has a karma system that rewards viewers for positive participation. This creates a fair, fun, and rewarding ecosystem for streamers, viewers, and developers.
how_its_made:
Streamer.fun is built on top of Kadena using Scaffold Kadena as the base framework. The core of the platform is powered by four smart contracts deployed on Kadena. These contracts are multichain by design, which means they can run across all 55 Kadena chains. This multichain architecture makes the system highly scalable and flexible.

On the AI side, the platform uses the Hedera Agent Kit, combined with LangChain and OpenAI services available through Hedera. This setup allows the creation and deployment of specialized agents. At present, there are three main types of agents:

RAG Agent for retrieval-augmented generation and context-based moderation.
Ad Agent for handling advertising and sponsorship tasks.
Moderation Agent for chat filtering, spam detection, and user interaction management.

The marketplace hosts all these agents, so streamers and developers can buy, sell, and deploy them. Ownership of agents is tracked and secured through NFTs on Kadena.

Currently, the project has an OG smart contract on testnet for RAG functionality. This contract also uses the OG storage and compute feature. Since the testnet has stability issues, alternative AI services are used when required.

Another key component is the Polymarket bot, which is built using Kadena’s multichain transfer system. Like the other contracts, it is deployed across five chains for multichain support. This bot enables prediction-market style interactions during live streams.

Finally, the platform introduces the idea of time as a real-world asset (RWA). A streamer’s time is tokenized, and users can purchase it with tokens. These tokens can be used to interact directly with the streamer, participate in giveaways, trade at higher value, or even keep as a digital memory.

This combination of Kadena’s multichain smart contracts, Hedera-powered AI agents, and tokenized streamer time makes Streamer.fun a unique decentralized ecosystem that blends blockchain, AI, and entertainment.
